subject: Private Deploy Onboarding: networking & access intake
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@hearthwellhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@hearthwellhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Private Deploy Onboarding: networking & access intake

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As promised I’m sending the initial network diagram and a short list of constraints so we can get the on-prem pilot scheduled. High level notes below and the diagram attached.

Quick constraints:
- Environment will be air-gapped with outbound-only egress through a restricted proxy (no incoming connections).
- Customer-managed KMS (Azure Key Vault) and HSM for private keys.
- CIDR space is pre-assigned by our infra team: 10.10.0.0/16; we prefer no overlapping with your public test ranges.
- We plan to use site-to-site VPN for control-plane traffic and a restricted peering for telemetry; need to confirm supported options.

Attached: hearthwell-network-diagram-v1.pdf

Immediate asks:
1) Can Redwood support a strictly outbound-only control plane connection pattern (TLS to Redwood endpoints) and list the IP ranges / FQDNs we should allow?
2) What firewall and port rules are required for the private deploy agent and KV/HSM integrations?
3) Any prebuilt bootstrap scripts you recommend for account setup and service accounts?

Appreciate a short checklist so our infra team can tick boxes before the kickoff.

Best,
Alex Mercer
Technical Program Manager
Hearthwell Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@hearthwellhealth.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@hearthwellhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Deploy Onboarding: networking & access intake

Hi Alex — thanks for the diagram and the constraints. Looping in Ben (on private-deploy ops) and Karthik (networking/egress patterns). Below is a compact intake checklist and answers to your three asks; I’ll follow up with a brief runbook we use that contains the scripts.

Short intake checklist (items for Hearthwell to complete before kickoff):
- Confirm a single source-of-truth CIDR block for the tenant (you listed 10.10.0.0/16).
- Provide KMS/HSM contact and a service account with minimal privileges for key retrieval during bootstrap.
- VPN endpoint IP and preferred tunnel parameters (IKEv2/RSA, preshared vs cert).
- Proxy egress FQDN allowlist (we’ll provide Redwood control-plane hostnames).
- SSH jumpbox plan for initial troubleshooting (IP, owner, access window).

Answers to your asks:
1) Outbound-only control plane: yes — Redwood supports outbound-only connections from the customer VPC to our control plane. We require TLS egress to these hostnames: api.redwood-infer.prod, bootstrap.redwood-infer.prod, metrics.redwood-infer.prod. I’ll attach a CSV of IP ranges; for pilot, allow outbound to 52.34.12.0/23 and 18.205.45.0/24 (we’ll provide final ranges in the onboarding runbook).
2) Firewall/ports: For agent/control-plane: 443 (TLS) outbound. For KV integration: 443 outbound to your KMIP/KeyVault endpoints. For optional telemetry: 443 outbound to metrics endpoint or 9411 for Zipkin if you opt in; we recommend keeping telemetry optional for air-gapped pilots.
3) Bootstrap scripts: we maintain a set of one-command bootstrap scripts (private_deploy/bootstrap.sh) that create service accounts, install the agent, and register the tenant. I’ll share a Drive link to scripts and a short sample that uses a service principal.

Attachments: hw-vpn-approach-answers.xlsx (answers + quick checklist), onboarding-scripts-drive-link (below).

Next step: Ben, can we schedule a 45-min technical intake with Hearthwell this week to confirm VPN params and KMS flow?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@hearthwellhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Deploy Onboarding: networking & access intake

Alex / team — I can take the intake call. Quick technical clarifications ahead of the meeting so we can keep it <45 mins: 

1) VPN mode: cert-based IKEv2 preferred for production; PSK allowed for pilot only. If you send your VPN config export (vendor + template), I’ll validate.
2) CIDR: we’ll need a small /28 for the control-plane NAT egress pool to make firewall rules deterministic; can you reserve 10.10.254.0/28 for that?
3) KMS flow: we support Azure Key Vault. We need a managed identity or service principal that has get/list permissions on the key. If you use HSM, we’ll need the key wrapping flow details (send over the KMIP endpoint and cert thumbprint).

I’ve attached a short checklist I use on calls (attachment: onboarding-ops-checklist.txt). Also: do you have any strict data residency windows or maintenance blackout dates this quarter that would affect a cutover?

If those look good, propose Thu 15 May 10:00am PT for the intake. Meeting invite to follow if that works.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Private Deploy Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@hearthwellhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@hearthwellhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private Deploy Onboarding: networking & access intake

Thanks — Thu 15 May 10:00am PT works for us. Quick answers inline: 

On VPN mode: we can do cert-based IKEv2 for production; for the pilot we’ll send a PSK config export (watch for a separate email).
CIDR: we can reserve 10.10.254.0/28 for your NAT egress pool — confirming with our network team now.
KMS: we will create a service principal with get/list on the key and share the principal id and a short-lived secret via the secure portal before the call. We have one blackout window May 22–24 for a quarterly backup; that’s outside the kickoff window.

Attachments: I’ve uploaded a slightly updated network diagram to the Drive link you shared.

See you Thu — I’ll accept the invite.

Best,
Alex
Technical Program Manager
Hearthwell Health
